---
# Negative control for the theme guard. Not an example: this poster exists to
# FAIL the render, and it lives outside examples/ for that reason.
#
# `unnl` is a typo for `unl`. Unknown theme names used to fall through to
# `generic`, so the poster printed in the wrong colours and said nothing about
# it — the same printed-once hazard as the size fixture beside this one.
title: "Theme guard fixture"
format:
  sciposter-typst:
    poster:
      size: a2
      columns: 1
      theme: unnl
---
